title: Bit Order Control of Channel Data

c.v: The channel data will be stored as the data to be input in order from high to low.
The data bit order in each channel is controlled by
0: The bit order of the data to be input is not reversed;
1: The bit order of the data to be input is reversed.
At this point, the first phase of data format control is complete.
The data to be input after bit order control is stored in the RX FIFO.
